meaning: 与朋友交换不想要的衣服
usageNote: 动词短语，超接地气！swap就是'换换换'，比exchange更随意，闺蜜聚会换衣服场合超适合用！

examples.en: Why not swap your unwanted clothes with friends instead of throwing them away?
examples.zh: 与其把不想要的衣服扔掉，为什么不和朋友交换呢？

examples.en: We organized a party to swap our unwanted clothes with friends and everyone left with something new!
examples.zh: 我们组织了一个派对和朋友互换旧衣服，每个人都带着新东西离开了！
